Sen. Christopher Bong Go

S00006

Almighty God, we come before you today seeking your wisdom, guidance, and strength as we fulfill the duties entrusted to us by the Filipino people. We pray for the peaceful conduct of the ongoing BARM elections and and for the continued success of the Bangsamoro Peace Process. Matagal nang pinagdadaanan ng ating mga kapatid sa Bangsamoro ang landas tungo sa kapayapaan. Naway magiging pagkakataon ng halalan upang mas marinig ang boses ng taong bayan at lalo pang mapagtibay ang kapayapaan, pagkakaisa, at pagunlad sa rehyon. Kami rin po ay pinili ng taong bayan upang maging kanilang mga kinatawan. Nawa'y huwag naming sayangin ang tiwalang ipinagkaloob nila sa amin sapagkat sa aming mga disisyon ay nakasalalay hindi lamang ang kasalukuyan kundi maging ang kinabukasan ng ating bansa at ng mga susunod na henerasyon. In this important moment for our nation, grant us clarity of mind and sincerity of heart. May we always be guided by truth, fairness, respect for our institutions, and above all, the welfare of every Filipino. Lord, as we perform our solemn duty as Senator-Judges, remind us that the credibility and integrity of this Court rests upon how faithfully and fairly we discharge our responsibilities. Tayo ang pinili at pinagkatiwalaan ng mahalagang tungkulin ito, naway maging patas at makatarungan kami sa bawat hakbang at disisyon aming gagawin. Lord, We also pray for our countrymen who continue to face the daily struggles of life sa gitna ng hirap ng buhay, pagtaas ng mga bilihin, mga sakuna, at iba pang pagsubok. Tulungan mo kaming huwag malimutan ang tunay na dahilan ng aming paglilingkod, ang mapabuti ang buhay ng bawat Pilipino. May this process never divide us as a nation, sa halip naway manaig ang ating pagkakabuklod-buklod Pagalang sa isa't isa at pagmamalasakit sa kapwa. I am for unity. I am for healing of this country. Sana matapos na ito para makatrabaho na tayo. Remind us that beyond our positions and responsibilities, we share one country and one responsibility to protect its people in its future. Guide each one of us to act according to our conscience, the Constitution, and the rule of law. Give us the humility to listen, the courage to do what is right, and the wisdom to place the interests of the Filipino people above all else. May our decisions contribute to a stronger, more peaceful, more united, and healed Philippines. All these we ask in your holy name. Amen.
